current_role: Governor of California (since January 2019; term ends January 2027)
summary: Gavin Newsom was mayor of San Francisco (2004–2011) and lieutenant governor before becoming governor of California in 2019. He has been one of Trump's most combative opponents, suing over the 2025 federalization of the California National Guard and backing the Proposition 50 redistricting measure. He polls second for the 2028 Democratic nomination and said he would decide after the midterms.
